findings.raw_C0_rate_metrics: C0 beat Marcel on future wOBA and runs_per_600 RMSE in every fold and both weighting views
findings.raw_C0_proper_scores: C0 lost both proper scores in V2022 but beat both in V2023 and V2024 in both views
findings.age_translation: worsened all four primary metrics in V2023 and V2024 in both views
findings.development: worsened future wOBA and runs_per_600 RMSE in V2023 and V2024 in both views; only V2023 player-weighted Brier improved
findings.calibration: available only in V2024; improved player-weighted rate RMSE but materially worsened PA-weighted rate RMSE and catastrophically worsened proper scores, led by FC_REACH, 3B, SF, HR, and HBP
findings.diagnosis: C0 contains useful future outcome signal; H0 failed through unstable transformation layers and rare-outcome calibration, not through absence of PBP outcome signal

decisions.next_candidate_policy: C0 stability core plus exactly one separately gated increment
